{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Tejas Gas Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline.<ref name=source1>[http://bit.ly/2sKCn2h Tejas Gas Pipeline,] A Barrel Full, accessed January 2018</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Refugio County, Texas, to Fort Bend County, Texas.

=== Eagle Ford Project (Freer to Sinton) ===
The pipeline runs from Freer, Texas to Sinton, Texas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ir.kindermorgan.com/news/news-details/2023/Kinder-Morgan-and-Howard-Energy-Partners-Announce-Expansions-of-Their-Respective-Eagle-Ford-Natural-Gas-Transportation-Systems/default.aspx|title=ir.kindermorgan.com|website=ir.kindermorgan.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/news/2023/july/kinder-morgan-expanding-eagle-ford-pipeline-systems-supplying-2-bcfd-of-gas-to-gulf-coast-markets|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Owner: '''Kinder Morgan Inc<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ir.kindermorgan.com/news/news-details/2023/Kinder-Morgan-and-Howard-Energy-Partners-Announce-Expansions-of-Their-Respective-Eagle-Ford-Natural-Gas-Transportation-Systems/default.aspx|title=ir.kindermorgan.com|website=ir.kindermorgan.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''2,000 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''67 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ir.kindermorgan.com/news/news-details/2023/Kinder-Morgan-and-Howard-Energy-Partners-Announce-Expansions-of-Their-Respective-Eagle-Ford-Natural-Gas-Transportation-Systems/default.aspx|title=ir.kindermorgan.com|website=ir.kindermorgan.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/news/2023/july/kinder-morgan-expanding-eagle-ford-pipeline-systems-supplying-2-bcfd-of-gas-to-gulf-coast-markets|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/pipelines/article/14296376/tejas-howard-energy-launch-2-bcfd-eagle-ford-gas-system-expansion|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''42 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ir.kindermorgan.com/news/news-details/2023/Kinder-Morgan-and-Howard-Energy-Partners-Announce-Expansions-of-Their-Respective-Eagle-Ford-Natural-Gas-Transportation-Systems/default.aspx|title=ir.kindermorgan.com|website=ir.kindermorgan.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/news/2023/july/kinder-morgan-expanding-eagle-ford-pipeline-systems-supplying-2-bcfd-of-gas-to-gulf-coast-markets|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ogj.com/pipelines-transportation/pipelines/article/14296376/tejas-howard-energy-launch-2-bcfd-eagle-ford-gas-system-expansion|title=ogj.com|website=ogj.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Background==
The pipeline was owned by Intergen in 2000, which was acquired by Kinder Morgan in 2001.<ref name="source1" /> The Tejas Gas Pipeline is owned by Kinder Morgan Energy Partners and operated by Kinder Morgan Tejas Pipeline LLC.<ref>[https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/private/snapshot.asp?privcapId=8250589 Company Overview of Kinder Morgan Tejas Pipeline LLC], Bloomberg, accessed January 2018</ref> The pipeline runs from south Texas along the Mexico border and the Texas Gulf Coast to near the Louisiana border and north from the Houston area to east Texas.
 
==Accident==
On February 15, 2017, a section of the pipeline exploded in a rural area near Refugio, Texas.<ref name=Reuters>[https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pipeline-fire-kindermorgan-texas/kinder-morgan-gas-pipeline-explodes-in-texas-no-injuries-idUSKBN15U1SS Kinder Morgan gas pipeline explodes in Texas, no injuries], Reuters, Feb. 15, 2017</ref> Nearby residents said the explosion felt "like an earthquake" or like a "thunder roll that wouldn't end."<ref name=Reuters>[https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pipeline-fire-kindermorgan-texas/kinder-morgan-gas-pipeline-explodes-in-texas-no-injuries-idUSKBN15U1SS Kinder Morgan gas pipeline explodes in Texas, no injuries], Reuters, Feb. 15, 2017</ref>
